Entry samples cover40ms through1850ms, settled state at1900ms is compared after an additional600ms.
pageVerification.measurementNotice: Final0.6-second reel evidence replaces earlier0.18/1.1-second evidence. Entry traces extend past1800ms; settled state at1900ms is compared600ms later. Existing hidden/transparent/pointer-none controls are explicitly excluded; inline links use actual text client rects.
